item.title: Morning Research Briefing: Ignoring a noisy metronome during dyadic drumming...
item.description:
Today's Morning Science Briefing:

  • Ignoring a noisy metronome during dyadic drumming — Laura Bishop, Dongho Kwak (Frontiers in Psychology, 2026)
  • Toward Music Medicine: A Framework for Music Features and Alzheimer’s Disease — Jueun Lee (Journal of Youth Impact, 2026)
  • A multidisciplinary systematic review for the role of digital human models in assessing and treating altered body experience in eating disorders — Giulia Brizzi, Margherita Boltri, Simone Borsci, Russell Weili Chan, Funda Yildirim, Steven Truijen, Giuseppe Riva, Sofia Scataglini (Computers in Human Behavior Reports, 2026)
